details.description: Grok 4.20 is a chat model from xAI, released in March 2026 (the 0309 dated snapshot) as part of the Grok 4.20 family alongside a Grok 4.20 Multi-agent model. This is the reasoning-enabled variant, which uses extended step-by-step reasoning before answering. It accepts text and image input and produces text output, with a 1,000,000-token context window, and supports function calling, structured outputs and the Batch API.
advantages: Accepts both text and image input for text output, per xAI's model documentation.
Uses extended reasoning before responding, unlike the grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning variant of the same model.
Supports native function calling and structured outputs, per xAI's documentation.
disadvantages: xAI's documentation states that logprobs and top_logprobs are not supported by grok-4.20 and newer models.
use_cases: Agentic workflows that call tools/functions as part of multi-step tasks
Tasks that benefit from extended reasoning before answering
Vision tasks that combine image and text input

notes: xAI's own pages describe the model with marketing language ('industry-leading speed', 'lowest hallucination rate on the market') that is not tied to a published benchmark number, so it is left out per the no-unattributed-superlatives rule; no evaluation scores were found on any page opened. Facts (1M context, image+text input to text output, xai provider) match the catalog. Model status is not labeled beta/preview/deprecated on the current models or release-notes pages.
